title: Iterated neighborhood expectation
statement: Let $G$ be a regular Unique Games instance, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on its variable-neighbor incidences. Its neighborhood expectation is the average, first over variables and then over the neighbors of each variable, of $f$ on the resulting incidence.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definition of a regular Unique Games instance and its finiteness assumptions.
